In cyclic electron flow involving photosystem I, electrons are recycled back to the electron transport chain rather than being passed to NADP+.  
This process pumps protons into the thylakoid lumen, generating a proton gradient used to synthesize ATP.  
No NADPH is produced, oxygen is not released (since photosystem II is not involved), and CO₂ reduction is not directly part of this process.  

Final answer: (A)
